images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One cohesive 2 by 2 art direction proof sheet for Mira, a premium 2D learning arcade for children age six. Four equal landscape panels, a slim warm-white cross gutter, no outer border. Panel 1: ochre and dark teal storybook workshop for a falling tile game; empty central area for a playfield, kiln and paper lantern silhouettes to the side. Panel 2: overhead mint and moss courtyard maze, a tiny chunky vermilion bubble rover, apricot sandstone blocks, bubble rings, paths that read at thumbnail size. Panel 3: side-on cloud garden for a jumping game, tiny cinnamon hare with teal scarf landing on a wide rounded floating grassy ledge, warm sky, clear silhouette. Panel 4: quiet nature observation close-up of one common orange goldfish in profile, anatomically coherent paired pectoral/pelvic, dorsal and tail fins, subtle aquarium water and two soft stems, no extra animal. Every panel the same collectible picture-book arcade art: matte gouache with fine dry paper grain, cut-paper silhouettes with controlled rounded contours, clean edges for sprites, charcoal-teal shadows, deep spruce and warm cream base, apricot and persimmon accents, subtle offset contact shadows, no dark gradients or glassmorphism, strong foreground/background value separation, calm background detail and immediately legible focal object. Looks professionally art directed and tactile, not generic school clip art or a dashboard. The sheet contains zero text, numbers, characters, interface overlays, logos or watermark. A polished wide landscape composition.

images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make one landscape environment atlas split into three perfectly equal horizontal strips stacked vertically, edge-to-edge, crisp straight horizontal separations at exactly 1/3 and 2/3, no gutter or outer border; each strip will be cropped out for a 16:9 game background, so distribute detail across edges and make the center quiet. Top: warmly lit ochre and deep spruce tile kiln workshop, lanterns, paper and pottery shelving near left and right, subdued cream open wall and floor in center. Middle: overhead mint and moss courtyard garden, foliage and apricot walls only around the outside frame, large completely empty olive-sage courtyard plane; NO internal paths, bricks or maze. Bottom: apricot sky over soft far misty blue-green mountains and cream clouds with leafy silhouette at one outside corner, NO platforms or characters. Art direction: matte gouache on fine dry paper grain, cut-paper silhouettes with controlled rounded contours, charcoal-teal shadows, deep spruce and warm cream base, apricot and persimmon accents, subtle offset contact shadows, professional picture-book game. Absolutely no objects obstructing center, no text, numbers, interface, characters, grids, watermark.

images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A real transparent RGBA sprite sheet, three equal columns and two equal rows, with six fully isolated sprites, every sprite centered in its own cell with generous transparent gaps and similar size; do not touch one another; no shadows outside silhouettes. Top row three animation frames of the exact same cinnamon rabbit with teal scarf facing right, first resting on all fours, second running with front paws out, third airborne with knees tucked. Bottom row exact positions: first a compact round vermilion bubble rover top-down seen from overhead, its bubble nozzle points RIGHT; second the SAME rover with two pearly bubbles immediately to its right (nozzle points RIGHT); third a single illustrated golden star-shaped collector sticker with embossed paper petals but no text. Premium storybook arcade: matte gouache, fine paper grain, clean cut paper edges, charcoal teal shadows, warm cream, deep spruce, apricot and persimmon highlights. No labels, marks, boxes, ground, background, logos or text. Every sprite entirely visible.
